description.narrative: (Egypt): Ensuring sustainable and resilient water resources for Egypt requires the collective efforts of the education community working in partnership with public sector policymakers and private sector champions. The Center of Excellence for Water informs national and local water policy formation, promotes efficient water use, and develops innovative applied research solutions for irrigation, agricultural and industrial water use, groundwater management, desalination, wastewater management, urban water planning, water infrastructure, and governance. The Center is hosted by Alexandria University in partnership with the American University in Cairo, both internationally recognized leaders in water research. The Center links academic researchers with the public and private sectors to generate policy and applied research, develop state-of-the-art curricula, and provide scholarships to address imminent challenges in Egypt's water sector. Using FY 2021 funding, the Center will develop sustainable university governance systems, modernize curriculum, fund applied research projects, facilitate student and faculty exchanges, provide internship opportunities, and expand connections between the private sector and universities..This activity is contributing to the higher education partnership directive
